items.title: Tennis rows sourced to player profiles rather than to a fixture page
items.detail: Ten round-of-16 pairings in the published desk are real, but the rows cite an ATP player biography page as their source. A player profile is not evidence that a match is scheduled. This desk re-sources each of them to the tournament's official daily schedule and re-reads it.

evidence.label: ATP daily schedule re-read by this desk

items.action: Re-sourced to the tournament schedule; the rows are republished with the fixture URL.

items.title: EuroLeague rows cited the BKT EuroCup endpoint
items.detail: Sixteen basketball rows in the published desk cite api-live.euroleague.net/v2/competitions/U/seasons/U2026/games and describe it as the EuroLeague. In that API the competition code U is the BKT EuroCup; the EuroLeague is code E. The endpoint queried this session for U2026 round 7 returns EuroCup fixtures dated 10-12 November 2026, not the October fixtures those rows describe. The EuroLeague rows are therefore re-sourced to competition E (E2026), which does contain them.

evidence.label: EuroCup endpoint the rows cited (code U)
EuroLeague endpoint this desk used (code E)

items.action: EuroLeague rows re-sourced to competition E and re-verified; the citation error is logged here.

items.title: Two official NHL goal totals disagree by up to two goals per club
items.detail: NHL.com's standings page counts a shootout win as a goal for and a shootout loss as a goal against; the NHL stats API excludes the shootout-deciding goal. For example Dallas is 23-15 on nhl.com/standings and 22-14 in the stats API. Both figures are official. This desk uses the nhl.com figures for every NHL row and does not blend the two.

evidence.label: nhl.com standings (includes shootout goal)
NHL stats API team summary (excludes it)

items.action: Documented; the nhl.com convention is used consistently and stated on the methodology page.
